title: Observability: chaos process-kill a ring node (recover to green)
description: Runs `nexus chaos observability process-kill --duration 15 --yes`. Process-kills nexus-loki on a Loki ring node (VIP holders spared), observes the impact, then restarts the service and polls /ready until the ring is whole again.

observe.what: observed-impact health probes during the kill, then cluster recovered = true (loki ring back to 3/3)

whatProves: ObservabilityAdapter.ApplyChaosAsync runs the embedded nexus-chaos.sh on a Loki/Tempo ring node (VIP holders spared) and recovers via a /ready poll.
